name: Standing Reach
description: Stand up, stretch tall and take a deep breath.

steps.title: Stand comfortably
steps.text: Place your feet about hip-width apart and let your arms rest.

steps.title: Reach up
steps.text: As you breathe in, slowly raise your arms and reach upward, lengthening through your whole body.

steps.title: Lower slowly
steps.text: As you breathe out, bring your arms down in a wide, slow arc.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Do this a few more times at an easy pace. Move slowly and only as far as feels comfortable. Stop if anything hurts.
